Message: You've won $1000! Click here to claim now.
Reason for Scam: Fake prize scam designed to lure victims into providing personal information.
Action to Take: Ignore the message and do not click the link. Report it as spam.

Message: Your PayPal account has been locked. Click here to verify.
Reason for Scam: Phishing scam pretending to be PayPal to steal login credentials.
Action to Take: Go to the official PayPal website and check your account directly.

Message: We detected unusual activity on your bank account. Call this number now!
Reason for Scam: Scammers impersonate banks to steal financial details.
Action to Take: Do not call the number. Contact your bank directly using their official website or phone number.

Message: Your Netflix subscription is expiring. Update your payment info now.
Reason for Scam: Fake subscription renewal scam aimed at stealing credit card details.
Action to Take: Log in to your Netflix account directly to check payment status.

Message: Congrats! You've been selected for a free vacation. Call us now!
Reason for Scam: Travel scam designed to make you pay hidden fees.
Action to Take: Ignore the message. If it sounds too good to be true, it probably is.

Message: URGENT: Your credit card has been suspended. Click this link to reactivate.
Reason for Scam: Urgency tactic to make you enter your card details on a fake website.
Action to Take: Never enter your credit card details from unsolicited messages. Contact your bank directly.
